job.title: Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform (m/w/d)
job.company: ALDI SÜD Digital GmbH & Co. oHG

tailoring.headline: Engineering & eCommerce Platform Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring & REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms and APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, SQL performance tuning, and RESTful APIs, combined with hands-on delivery across cloud deployments, Docker, and Kubernetes. Experienced in agile environments, requirements analysis, code reviews, and working with international stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: With 5+ years of hands-on backend and platform engineering experience building scalable enterprise e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I was excited to see the Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform opening at ALDI SÜD Digital GmbH & Co. oHG. My background spans high-throughput API architectures, database optimization, and agile delivery across global commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Platform Engineering & REST APIs
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation and Shell, I designed and exposed high-performance RESTful APIs, OCC Web Services, and headless commerce integrations to support robust multi-channel e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Technical Leadership
bullets.text: I actively operated within agile engineering workflows, performing code reviews, mentoring junior developers, and translating complex business requirements into technical solutions.

bullets.label: Cloud & Containerization
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles, release builds, and platform maintenance utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-hosted environments.

bullets.label: SQL & Data Optimization
bullets.text: I engineered database query refactoring and data pipelines across complex ERP and PIM architectures, significantly reducing response latency and ensuring high data consistency.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my platform engineering experience fits your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit über 5 Jahren fundierter Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung skalierbarer Enterprise-E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell verfolge ich die technologische Weiterentwicklung von ALDI SÜD Digital mit großem Interesse. Meine Expertise umfasst den Aufbau robuster REST-APIs, performanter Datenarchitekturen und agiler Entwicklungsprozesse.

bullets.label: Plattformentwicklung & REST APIs
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation und Shell konzipierte und implementierte ich performante RESTful APIs, OCC Web Services und Headless-Commerce-Integrationen für komplexe Systemlandschaften.

bullets.label: Agile Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: Ich arbeitete eng in agilen Teams, steuerte Code-Reviews bei, unterstützte die technische Weiterentwicklung und setzte geschäftliche Anforderungen präzise in funktionale Softwarelösungen um.

bullets.label: Cloud & Containerisierung
bullets.text: Ich führte CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds in Cloud-Umgebungen durch und nutzte dabei Container-Technologien wie Docker und Kubernetes.

bullets.label: Datenbankoptimierung
bullets.text: Durch gezieltes Refactoring von SQL-Abfragen und die Optimierung von Daten-Pipelines verbesserte ich Systemstabilität und Transaktionsgeschwindigkeiten nachhaltig.

cover_de.logistics: Ich befinde mich in einem ungekündigten Arbeitsverhältnis mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026 und stehe Ihnen ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung. Ich verfüge über eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis und freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: ALDI SÜD Digital shapes global retail through innovative e-commerce platforms and modern engineering. I want to bring my 5+ years of backend architecture, cloud deployment, and API integration experience to help scale high-performance digital fulfillment solutions in a fast-paced agile environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving scalable e-commerce platforms, REST APIs, and cloud solutions through robust backend engineering and agile delivery.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi! With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms, REST APIs, and cloud-integrated systems at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I'm very interested in the Engineering Manager role at ALDI SÜD. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application for the Engineering Manager - eCommerce Platform position at ALDI SÜD Digital GmbH & Co. oHG.

With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms, REST APIs, and scalable backend solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical expertise and agile delivery experience.

I possess a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026 (serving notice until 15.12.2026).

I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
